text.arabic_uthmani: ۞ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَعْلَمُ أَنَّكَ تَقُومُ أَدْنَىٰ مِن ثُلُثَىِ ٱلَّيْلِ وَنِصْفَهُۥ وَثُلُثَهُۥ وَطَآئِفَةٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلَّذِينَ مَعَكَ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ يُقَدِّرُ ٱلَّيْلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ ۚ عَلِمَ أَن لَّن تُحْصُوهُ فَتَابَ عَلَيْكُمْ ۖ فَٱقْرَءُوا۟ مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنَ ٱلْقُرْءَانِ ۚ عَلِمَ أَن سَيَكُونُ مِنكُم مَّرْضَىٰ ۙ وَءَاخَرُونَ يَضْرِبُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ يَبْتَغُونَ مِن فَضْلِ ٱللَّهِ ۙ وَءَاخَرُونَ يُقَٰتِلُونَ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ فَٱقْرَءُوا۟ مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنْهُ ۚ وَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتُوا۟ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَأَقْرِضُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًۭا ۚ وَمَا تُقَدِّمُوا۟ لِأَنفُسِكُم مِّنْ خَيْرٍۢ تَجِدُوهُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ هُوَ خَيْرًۭا وَأَعْظَمَ أَجْرًۭا ۚ وَٱسْتَغْفِرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ ۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌۭ رَّحِيمٌۢ

In the discourse flow, the ayah first tells where the good is found, then what it is worth; custody precedes valuation. Within the ayah echo-pattern, god is bounty-source, loan-recipient, and deposit-holder; the economy never leaves divine relation.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The chain 'your Lord knows ... God measures ... He knew you would not enumerate it ... recite what is easy' joins exact divine knowledge to bounded human performance.
baseline_models.mechanism: Exact measure remains with God; failed human enumeration triggers an accessible recited portion rather than cancellation of observance.

activation_trace.role: The branch's disclosure of a thing to the knower makes actual effort and limitation fully visible to divine knowledge.
Measured deliberative governance supplies the exact calibration assigned to God.
Exhaustive numerical reckoning names the human operation declared unsustainable.
Reading and recitation provide the repeatable practice retained after exact duration is relinquished.
Opening and ease after difficulty make availability, rather than a fixed quantity, the operative limit.

changed_reading.before: The verse merely relaxes a quantified night requirement because exact compliance failed.
changed_reading.after: It relocates exactness to divine measuring while giving humans an accessible, repeatable form of observance; accommodation preserves the practice by changing its human unit.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: A group stands with the addressee, while the sick, travelers seeking bounty, fighters, worshippers, almsgivers, and lenders occupy different conditions under the repeated easy-recitation rule.
baseline_models.mechanism: The ayah organizes a plural community by capacity and vocation: common recital accompanies differentiated bodily, economic, defensive, ritual, and distributive work.

activation_trace.role: An encircling, gathered group gives the standing cohort a communal rather than solitary shape.
Weakening and curtailed movement supply a bodily capacity constraint.
Striving through the land supplies mobile livelihood as a second capacity condition.
Active seeking makes travel purposive pursuit of provision rather than mere absence.
Mutual combat supplies the severe public obligation borne by another cohort.
Obligatory worship stabilizes a shared practice amid differing conditions.
A portion of wealth or work cut out for return turns capacity into transferable benefit.

changed_reading.before: The verse lists exceptions to night practice and then appends ordinary duties.
changed_reading.after: It maps a differentiated community whose illness, livelihood, defense, worship, and giving are distinct capacity-bearing channels held together by flexible recital.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The inability to enumerate the night is followed by lending, sending good ahead, finding it with God, and receiving a greater wage.
baseline_models.mechanism: A failed temporal ledger is answered by a forward-transfer ledger: intentionally advanced good is preserved, encountered, and amplified beyond the performer's exact counting.

activation_trace.role: Exhaustive counting supplies the ledger operation humans cannot complete for the vigil.
Cutting out property or work for a returned recompense supplies the deposit transaction.
Advancing ahead gives the good deed a temporal direction toward a later encounter.
Coming upon the thing again supplies retrieval rather than disappearance.
Payment for work names the returned value of the advance.
Magnitude and strength mark the return as amplified rather than merely restored.

changed_reading.before: Good deeds receive a later reward despite imperfect night observance.
changed_reading.after: What cannot be perfectly totalled as devotional time can still be deliberately advanced as good and later encountered as an enlarged recompense.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The Lord who knows the performers' limits turns toward them, names sickness, and closes the adjusted command with forgiveness and mercy.
baseline_models.mechanism: Lordship functions as nurture and repair: exposure of incompleteness leads to a practicable form, while forgiveness covers the performer from the deficit's effects.

activation_trace.role: Repair, nurture, and completion make lordship the governing care behind the adjustment.
Attending to the sick turns a listed exception into an image of active care.
Covering a fault and protecting its bearer supplies the protective function of forgiveness.
Tender mercy gives the closing protection an affective and relational quality.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Divine measuring corrects human exhaustive counting.** `ع ل م` B001 supplies knowledge as a thing becomes clear; `ق د ر` B001 supplies measured extent and B005 arrangement by estimate and deliberation; `ح ص ي` B002 supplies counting until encompassed, including inability to attain what is counted. The ayah repeats `علم`, attributes night/day proportioning to God, and explicitly negates human encompassing. I infer that knowledge of actual practice authorizes a shift from exact schedule to feasible performance. The opening commands are not canceled; they are recalibrated by asymmetry between divine measure and human count.

2. **Ease is a dynamic opening matched to varied capacity.** `ي س ر` B001 supplies ease and ready opening, B002 a small amount, and B005 light, pliant movement. The phrase `ما تيسر` is repeated around sickness, travel for bounty, and fighting; `م ر ض` B001 supplies departure from health and balance. I infer that ease is what becomes genuinely available under changing bodily and social conditions, not a new fixed minimum. The recitation command reads as adaptive access to the gathered utterance.

3. **Night standing expands into a distributed economy of maintenance.** `ق و م` B002 anchors night standing, B004 care and preservation, and B009 support or subsistence; the later imperative `أقيموا الصلاة` repeats the root. Around it, `ء ت ي` B002 is granting, `ز ك و` B001/B002 is growth and purity, and `ق ر ض` B003 is a repayable advance awaiting recompense. I infer that the posture trained at night becomes social and ritual maintenance through established prayer, transferred wealth, and lending. `تقوم` and `أقيموا` thus frame one continuous practice of making persons and community stand.

4. **Travel and combat specify the earlier daytime “swimming.”** `ض ر ب` B002 explicitly supplies setting out through the land for livelihood or God’s path; `ب غ ي` B001 supplies seeking; `ف ض ل` B003 supplies bounty; `ق ت ل` B011 supplies mutual combat and B012 self-devoting struggle. These are the packet-supplied concrete activities placed beside illness. I infer that 73:7’s long daytime circulation is now partitioned into economic, martial, and bodily constraints. The final ayah reads the night rule from within real mobility rather than an isolated ritual timetable.

5. **The good loan converts severance into recoverable value.** `ق ر ض` B001 supplies cutting something off, while B003 supplies a repayable cut-off advance; `ح س ن` B001/B002 supplies goodness and beneficent action. `ق د م` B004 supplies sending ahead, and `و ج د` B001 supplies finding what was sent `عند الله`. I infer an exchange mechanism: property is cut from present possession, advanced, and encountered later as better value. The ayah makes giving materially intelligible as transfer rather than disappearance.

6. **Final forgiveness is consequence-shielding after acknowledged limits.** `غ ف ر` B001 supplies protective covering and B002 forgiveness that shields from consequence; `ر ح م` B001 supplies mercy and B002 kinship bond. The request follows admitted inability to encompass, adaptive ease, and commanded action. I infer that protection does not replace practice but covers the shortfall remaining after proportionate effort. `غفور رحيم` closes the surah by joining juridical shielding to relational care.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: No later ayah remains to activate a new relation. Within this final ayah itself, however, the return of roots from the entire surah—standing, night, half, day, recitation, taking a path, earth, bounty, and mercy—retrospectively reorganizes earlier commands as a capacity-sensitive whole.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Measured duty adjusted at the limit of human accounting.** **Lexical evidence:** `ث ل ث B002` and `ن ص ف B001` supply exact fractions; `ق د ر B001` is measure reaching a thing's extent, `ح ص ي B002` is exhaustive numerical encompassing and inability to attain it, and `ي س ر B001` is ease or ready possibility. **Structural cue and role:** observed fractions are followed by divine measurement of night and day, human non-encompassment, and then the repeated instruction to recite what becomes feasible. **Abductive move:** the sequence and `فـ` transitions are supplied; I infer that the eased form responds to finite human reckoning rather than revoking the measured practice's purpose. **Reading change:** accommodation is calibrated substitution at a capacity limit, not abandonment of discipline.

2. **Solitary standing expands into maintained communal worship.** **Lexical evidence:** `ق و م B002` is standing upright, while `ق و م B004` is care, maintenance, and preservation; `ص ل و B003` is prescribed worship. **Structural cue and role:** singular `تقوم` is joined by `طائفة ... معك`, and later plural `أقيموا الصلاة` reuses the standing root in the causative form. **Abductive move:** the root echo, number shift, and explicit group are supplied; I infer a movement from one person's standing to a practice a community keeps standing. **Reading change:** the night posture matures into the sustained maintenance of a shared worship structure.

3. **Recitation gathers a dispersed community without erasing its conditions.** **Lexical evidence:** in `ق ر ء B001`, one accepted variant is collecting and gathering and the other is gathering speech into recitation. **Structural cue and role:** a night-standing group is followed by sick people, travelers seeking bounty, and fighters, with `فاقرؤوا ما تيسر` repeated on both sides of the role-list. The two variants let recitation gather different lives around common speech while preserving differentiated capacities. **Abductive move:** the groups, repetition, and variant images are supplied; I infer that the repeated practice is the connective element across dispersion. **Reading change:** recitation becomes a communal integrator, not a demand for identical schedules.

4. **Ease as resilient practice across real constraints.** **Lexical evidence:** `ي س ر B001` is ease and ready opening, `م ر ض B001` is departure from health, `ض ر ب B002` is traveling through the land for livelihood, and `ق ت ل B011` is mutual fighting. **Structural cue and role:** the repeated ease formula encloses illness, trade travel, and combat, three conditions that alter available time and bodily capacity. **Abductive move:** the constraints and repeated command are supplied; I infer that continuity is preserved by scaling the practice to what each condition opens. **Reading change:** `ما تيسر` is not mere convenience; it is the rule that makes a common discipline robust under heterogeneous strain.

5. **A cut-off advance travels forward and returns as found recompense.** **Lexical evidence:** `ق ر ض B001` is cutting something off, `ق ر ض B003` is a repayable cut-off advance, `ق د م B004` is sending or going ahead, `و ج د B001` is finding what is sought, and `ء ج ر B001` is recompense for work. **Structural cue and role:** `أقرضوا ... قرضا` is followed by `ما تقدموا ... تجدوه ... أجرا`, an explicit chain from present transfer to forward placement to later finding. **Abductive move:** the temporal sequence is supplied; I infer that the divine loan image is not divine need but custody and return across time. **Reading change:** what is cut away from present possession is represented as value stored ahead rather than value lost.

6. **Giving enters a circuit of growth rather than depletion.** **Lexical evidence:** `ء ت ي B002` is granting or giving and `ء ت ي B007` is yield or produced increase; `ز ك و B001` is growth, `ف ض ل B001/B003` is surplus and bounty, and `خ ي ر B005` is beneficence or gift. **Structural cue and role:** some seek divine bounty through travel; the ayah then commands giving, growth-marked alms, and a good loan, before declaring the found result better and greater. **Abductive move:** surplus, transfer, growth, and enlarged return are supplied; I infer a circulation in which received bounty becomes given benefit and reappears with increased value. **Reading change:** the economic commands form one productive value-cycle rather than unrelated acts of subtraction.

7. **Forgiveness supplies the effective cover the prior event removed.** **Lexical evidence:** `غ ف ر B001` is protective covering, `غ ف ر B002` is forgiveness that shields from consequence, and `ر ح م B001` is mercy and beneficence. **Structural cue and role:** 73:17 asked how protection could be achieved, 73:18 split the overhead cover, and this ayah closes human non-encompassment and commanded action with seeking forgiveness and the names `غفور رحيم`. **Abductive move:** failed ordinary cover, human shortfall, petition, and protective branches are supplied; I infer that forgiveness is the viable shelter from consequence. **Reading change:** the closing names answer the earlier protection problem functionally: mercy provides a cover that the ruptured sky and concealed truth cannot.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: No later ayah exists in the packet, so no later surprise emerged for this final fixed ayah.

baseline.text: Şüphesiz Rabbin, senin gecenin üçte ikisinden biraz daha azında, yarısında ve üçte birinde ayakta kaldığını ve seninle birlikte olanlardan bir topluluğun da bunu yaptığını biliyor. Geceyi ve gündüzü Allah ölçüp belirler. O, sizin bunu tam olarak hesaplayamayacağınızı bildi ve tövbenizi kabul etti. O hâlde Kur'an'dan kolayınıza geleni okuyun. İçinizde hastalar olacağını, başkalarının Allah'ın lütfunu aramak için yeryüzünde yolculuk edeceğini ve başkalarının Allah yolunda savaşacağını bildi. Öyleyse ondan kolayınıza geleni okuyun; namazı kılın, zekâtı verin ve Allah'a güzel bir borç verin. Kendiniz için önceden gönderdiğiniz her iyiliği Allah katında daha iyi ve ödül bakımından daha büyük olarak bulacaksınız. Allah'tan bağışlanma dileyin. Şüphesiz Allah çok bağışlayandır, çok merhametlidir.

findings.text: İlahi ölçme ile insanın bütünüyle sayıp kuşatamaması arasındaki fark, kesin gece oranlarını güce göre yapılabilen okuyuşa dönüştüren ayarın gerekçesidir.
Kolaylık yeni ve değişmez bir alt sınır değildir; hastalık, yolculuk ve savaş gibi değişen koşullarda gerçekten açılan imkâna göre hareket eden esnek bir ölçüdür.
Gece ayakta durma, topluluğu ayakta tutan bakıma dönüşür; tek kişinin duruşu, birlikte sürdürülen namazın kurulması ve korunmasıyla genişler.
Tekrarlanan okuyuş, hastaları, yolcuları ve savaşanları aynı söz çevresinde toplarken onların farklı güç ve zaman koşullarını silmez.
Güzel borç, eldeki değerden kesilip öne gönderilen ve daha sonra Allah katında daha iyi bir karşılık olarak bulunan bir aktarım zinciridir.
Lütufla elde edilen fazlalığın zekât ve iyilik olarak verilmesi, eksilme değil, verilen değerin büyüyerek yeniden ortaya çıktığı bir dolaşım oluşturur.
Bağışlanma, insanın kabul edilmiş sınırlarından sonra kalan eksikliği sonuçtan koruyan örtüdür; merhamet bu korumayı yakınlık ve gözetim ilişkisine yerleştirir.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P2 - Deferred Appointment and Irreversible Arrival
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Delay belongs to a fixed schedule whose promised event ultimately arrives, occurs, and acquires the force of an accomplished act.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Temporal reckoning extends into moon stations, lunar halos, star markers, weekday naming, and the contrast between first, later, and terminal positions.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: A short reprieve before an appointed time
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A period of calm delay is granted, but it remains bounded by a specified appointment.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: deliberate delay and absence of haste (`quranic:root_001452:B001/m01`); a small interval (`quranic:root_001251:B001/m01`); postponement to a later time (`quranic:root_000019:B002/m01`); an appointment fixed by time or place (`quranic:root_001662:B003/m01`); a duration of time (`quranic:root_001700:B002/m01`); an event present in time (`quranic:root_001332:B001/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Delay is not cancellation but a measured opening before an appointment. “Later” and temporal occurrence keep the reprieve inside a schedule whose endpoint remains intact.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P2 - Deferred Appointment and Irreversible Arrival

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Promise becoming an accomplished event
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A verbal commitment advances from expectation through arrival to enacted fact.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: a promise opening expectation (`quranic:root_001662:B001/m01`); threatening promise (`quranic:root_001662:B002/m01`); coming and arrival (`quranic:root_000009:B001/m01`); calamity arriving upon a person (`quranic:root_000009:B011/m01`); return to an outcome or final meaning (`quranic:root_000067:B002/m01`); occurrence in time (`quranic:root_001332:B001/m01`); an enacted deed (`quranic:root_001167:B001/m01`); a calamitous day or event (`quranic:root_001700:B003/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The sequence closes the distance between saying and reality. Arrival supplies the transition, occurrence supplies presence, action realizes it, and outcome names what the event finally becomes or means.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Moon position, halo, stellar mansion, and named days provide observable markers for scheduled time.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: the moon taking successive stations (`quranic:root_000018:B008/m01`); a lunar halo (`quranic:root_001613:B003/m01`); a lunar mansion of three stars (`quranic:root_001096:B006/m01`); a guiding mark or landmark (`quranic:root_001040:B002/m01`); the named day Tuesday (`quranic:root_000203:B006/m01`); daylight as a bounded unit (`quranic:root_001700:B001/m01`); an observable sign promising a future condition (`quranic:root_001662:B006/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: These motifs form a practical timekeeping scene: celestial position is observed, marked, grouped, and translated into named units. The promised day is thus pressured by a latent calendar whose signs make an appointment legible.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: First, later, forward, and rear positions
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A scheduled sequence distinguishes its beginning and predecessors from later, forward, and rearward positions.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: beginning or first position (`quranic:root_000067:B001/m01`); precedence in age, merit, or movement (`quranic:root_001452:B002/m01`); what comes after the first (`quranic:root_000019:B001/m01`); a rearward position (`quranic:root_000019:B003/m01`); forward advance or precedence (`quranic:root_001207:B004/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Temporal order is made spatially legible. First and later establish sequence, precedence and advance establish relative movement, and the rear establishes the opposite position; deferred arrival therefore remains an ordered displacement, not an indefinite pause.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P2 - Punitive Closure of Movement and Intake
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Punishment closes ordinary passages: limbs cannot move, the throat cannot pass food, and heat cannot be escaped.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Fetters, a wrestling hold, a neck grip, an unwholesome meal, molten residue, and war-fire form one system of bodily closure rather than separate punishment images.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Binding, capture, and the neck grip
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A body is seized, restrained by iron, and controlled at the neck or throat.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: a shackle that prevents movement (`quranic:root_001554:B001/m01`); arrest and capture (`quranic:root_000018:B003/m01`); wrestling hold (`quranic:root_000018:B011/m01`); taking hold around the neck (`quranic:root_000957:B009/m01`); gripping and crushing the throat (`quranic:root_000934:B012/m01`); direct striking (`quranic:root_000906:B001/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Restraint proceeds from limb to neck: shackle prevents locomotion, capture removes agency, and the grappling hold concentrates control at the throat. The punitive scene is therefore mechanically continuous.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: blazing infernal fire (`quranic:root_000225:B001/m01`); exposure to fire and its heat (`quranic:root_000879:B001/m01`); molten metal, oily dregs, or pus-like residue (`quranic:root_001452:B003/m01`); punishment by severe pain (`quranic:root_000994:B005/m01`); harmful heaviness (`quranic:root_001619:B002/m01`); clamor of fire and war (`quranic:root_001434:B001/m01`); marching in extreme heat (`quranic:root_001434:B002/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 73:11 `مَهِّلْهُمْ`; 73:12 `جَحِيمًا`; 73:13 `عَذَابًا`; 73:16 `وَبِيلًا`; 73:20 `صَّلَوٰةَ`; surface anchors unavailable for `quranic:root_001434:B001` and `quranic:root_001434:B002` because `م ع ع` is missing from root coverage
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The scene combines radiant heat, direct burning, molten residue, and suffocating clamor. Even movement through the environment becomes a march inside heat, completing the closure of escape.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P2 - Failure of Earthly, Celestial, and Hydraulic Containment
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Structures that normally support, cover, or channel material lose integrity and release what they hold.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Mountain collapse, sky rupture, flood, runoff, and hidden erosion are variants of one containment failure across solid, aerial, and liquid media.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Water exceeding channels and boundaries
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Heavy rain and imported runoff overwhelm the distinction between channel, land, and enclosing wall.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: an encircling flood (`quranic:root_000957:B002/m01`); heavy rain with large drops (`quranic:root_001619:B001/m01`); rain exceeding ordinary need (`quranic:root_000138:B006/m01`); runoff arriving from another land (`quranic:root_000009:B005/m01`); rain hanging between cloud and earth (`quranic:root_000672:B005/m01`); weather striking earth and vegetation (`quranic:root_000906:B013/m01`); a fortified enclosing wall (`quranic:root_000957:B010/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Rain descends, runoff arrives laterally, and flood circles the site until ordinary boundaries fail. The enclosing wall supplies the expected defense whose insufficiency makes the inundation a true collapse scene.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P2 - Failure of Earthly, Celestial, and Hydraulic Containment
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Structures that normally support, cover, or channel material lose integrity and release what they hold.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Mountain collapse, sky rupture, flood, runoff, and hidden erosion are variants of one containment failure across solid, aerial, and liquid media.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Managed flow as the failed baseline
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Water is ordinarily directed through a channel, gathered in a basin, retained at a source, and released into a river.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: a watercourse and the directing of its flow (`quranic:root_000009:B004/m01`); a basin that retains water (`quranic:root_000018:B006/m01`); abundant well or sea water (`quranic:root_001040:B005/m01`); gathered water (`quranic:root_000532:B013/m01`); a river (`quranic:root_001559:B001/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Channel, basin, source, store, and river define a controlled hydraulic system. That ordinary sequence supplies the baseline against which excess runoff and rupture become failures of containment rather than undifferentiated water imagery.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P2 - Message Tested by Testimony and Enactment
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A communicated claim is tested by witness, enacted fact, and the quality of its recipients’ response.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Falsehood appears not only as lying but as a failed charge, deceptive cloth, rumor-induced panic, and fabricated composition.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Commitment verified by action
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A promise is judged true when a corresponding act occurs and becomes observable fact.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: verbal commitment (`quranic:root_001662:B001/m01`); mutual commitment (`quranic:root_001662:B004/m01`); an enacted deed (`quranic:root_001167:B001/m01`); occurrence in time (`quranic:root_001332:B001/m01`); knowledgeable disclosure (`quranic:root_001040:B001/m01`); finding an object as present (`quranic:root_001626:B001/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Promise and action are not merged: promise establishes the claim, occurrence gives it temporal presence, knowledge recognizes it, and finding supplies experiential verification. The “fulfilled promise” is therefore a completed evidentiary chain.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P2 - Covering, Protection, and Exposure
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A covering may preserve what is within, conceal what should be known, or fail and expose its contents.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Protective barrier, fruit casing, eye film, garment, roof edge, forgiveness, disbelief, and sky cover all turn on the ethics and mechanics of concealment.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Concealing truth and covering fault
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Covering either suppresses a recognized truth or shields a wrongdoer from the consequence of fault.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: basic covering and concealment (`quranic:root_001307:B001/m01`); denial that hides truth (`quranic:root_001307:B003/m01`); covering or denying a benefit (`quranic:root_001307:B004/m01`); covering sin and protecting its bearer from its effect (`quranic:root_001096:B002/m01`); removing an offense as though covered (`quranic:root_001307:B009/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The shared action of covering yields opposed moral relations. Denial uses a cover to suppress truth or benefit; forgiveness uses it to contain fault and prevent its destructive consequence.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P2 - Compressed Life Cycle
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Birth, growth, maturation, and aging can be accelerated until distant life stages collapse into one event.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The child-to-grey transformation is supported by a detailed reproductive ledger of womb, afterbirth, childbirth blood, near delivery, tooth eruption, and derived new life.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Womb, delivery, and afterbirth
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Gestation approaches term, the child emerges, and bodily traces of delivery remain.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: womb as the vessel of offspring (`quranic:root_000552:B003/m01`); labor and placing down the child (`quranic:root_001683:B003/m01`); a newborn child (`quranic:root_001683:B004/m01`); afterbirth and womb discharge (`quranic:root_000994:B009/m01`); birth fluid or sign of maturity (`quranic:root_000822:B006/m01`); childbirth and postpartum blood (`quranic:root_001533:B005/m01`); nearing delivery (`quranic:root_000493:B004/m01`); postpartum uterine pain (`quranic:root_000552:B004/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The motifs occupy successive roles in one birth scene: containing organ, approaching term, delivery, newborn, fluid trace, blood, and after-pain. This gives the surface’s children an extended biological origin rather than treating age as an isolated image.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: generation of one thing from another (`quranic:root_001683:B005/m01`); creating and beginning (`quranic:root_001165:B002/m01`); tooth eruption (`quranic:root_001165:B007/m01`); growth and increase (`quranic:root_000637:B001/m01`); yield and production (`quranic:root_000009:B007/m01`); making or creating (`quranic:root_000248:B001/m01`)

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: parents (`quranic:root_001683:B002/m01`); kinship and family bond (`quranic:root_000552:B002/m01`); household or attached followers (`quranic:root_000067:B003/m01`); a caretaker and stepchild relation (`quranic:root_000532:B005/m01`); an age peer (`quranic:root_001683:B006/m01`)

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Reproductive interval and recurrence
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Menstruation alternates with purity, while the interval itself supplies a recurring unit for waiting and reproductive time.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: menstrual phase and its completion (`quranic:root_001210:B003/m01`); interval of purity and waiting between phases (`quranic:root_001210:B003/m02`); the appointed recurrence of menstruation and purity (`quranic:root_001211:B002/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The branches distinguish bodily phase, intervening interval, and cyclic return. This recurrent reproductive clock supplies the ordinary temporal baseline from which gestation begins and against which the surah’s immediate child-to-grey transformation appears radically compressed.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P2 - Volition, Compulsion, and Viable Capacity
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Action can arise from chosen direction, external coercion, or a capacity calibrated to what is actually possible.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Choice is pressured by lexical scenes of forcing, deterrent restraint, suitability, preparation, illness, and eased passage.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Capacity adjusted to ease and suitability
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A task is planned to fit available strength, health, and circumstances so it can be performed without collapse.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: effective ability and mastery (`quranic:root_001205:B003/m01`); a thing fitting its measure (`quranic:root_001205:B006/m01`); ease after difficulty (`quranic:root_001694:B001/m01`); what is suitable or readily possible (`quranic:root_000138:B002/m01`); an approach that prepares the affair (`quranic:root_000009:B003/m01`); weakened action and short movement (`quranic:root_001415:B004/m01`); suitability to one’s condition (`quranic:root_000637:B004/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Capacity is relational, not absolute. Measure, suitability, preparation, and ease adapt the operation to impaired movement and changing circumstance, explaining how obligation can remain real while its quantity changes.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P2 - Paths of Approach, Livelihood, and Combat
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A way becomes meaningful through its destination and the kind of effort conducted along it.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The same route system supports spiritual approach, commerce, scouting, return from travel, and military advance, with landmarks and lateral choices preventing “way” from remaining abstract.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Route, landmark, and directed approach
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A traveler identifies a road by its markers, establishes direction, and approaches a destination.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: a road or means of access (`quranic:root_000672:B001/m01`); a guiding landmark (`quranic:root_001040:B002/m01`); a traveled thoroughfare and terminal line (`quranic:root_000009:B010/m01`); nearness and approach (`quranic:root_000493:B001/m01`); front or leading edge (`quranic:root_001207:B007/m01`); presence at the destination (`quranic:root_001052:B004/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Road, landmark, forepart, nearness, and arrival assign concrete roles to path-taking. Direction is not merely moral orientation; it is a navigable approach whose progress can be observed.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P2 - Paths of Approach, Livelihood, and Combat
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A way becomes meaningful through its destination and the kind of effort conducted along it.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The same route system supports spiritual approach, commerce, scouting, return from travel, and military advance, with landmarks and lateral choices preventing “way” from remaining abstract.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Commercial travel in search of surplus
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Travelers cross the land to seek resources, conduct partnership trade, and return with gain.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: travel through the land for livelihood (`quranic:root_000906:B002/m01`); seeking a desired resource (`quranic:root_000138:B001/m01`); surplus remaining after need (`quranic:root_001163:B001/m01`); non-obligatory gift or benefit (`quranic:root_001163:B003/m01`); commercial partnership (`quranic:root_000906:B016/m01`); capital entrusted for trade (`quranic:root_001217:B004/m01`); wealth and means (`quranic:root_001626:B003/m01`); return from travel (`quranic:root_001207:B005/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The route supports a full commercial process: search, travel, pooled capital, productive effort, surplus, and return. “Seeking bounty” is thereby grounded in a recognizable economy rather than generalized striving.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P2 - Paths of Approach, Livelihood, and Combat

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Lateral deviation and positional choice
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A traveler can refuse the direct line, separate toward one side, pass laterally, or choose a forward or rearward position.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: refusal and deviation from a true course (`quranic:root_001052:B001/m01`); side-separation (`quranic:root_001052:B002/m01`); passing a place to one side (`quranic:root_001217:B002/m01`); taking the left side (`quranic:root_001694:B004/m01`); the rear or later position (`quranic:root_000019:B003/m01`); forward advance (`quranic:root_001207:B004/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: A path includes crosswise decisions as well as forward progress. Deviation, separation, bypass, leftward movement, rear position, and advance map the alternatives by which an intended approach can be maintained or lost.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P2 - Measured Contribution and Returned Value
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A contribution is first apportioned, then transferred, and finally recovered as value, benefit, or reward.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Night fractions and devotional giving share the same operational grammar of amount, ledger, advance, loan, equivalent return, and multiplied value.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Portioning and counting the night
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A duration is divided into exact fractions, estimated, counted, and adjusted to a manageable amount.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: the number three (`quranic:root_000203:B001/m01`); a third portion (`quranic:root_000203:B002/m01`); one half (`quranic:root_001511:B001/m01`); reaching a midpoint (`quranic:root_001511:B002/m01`); specified quantity and limit (`quranic:root_001205:B001/m01`); planning by calculation (`quranic:root_001205:B005/m01`); exhaustive counting (`quranic:root_000332:B002/m01`); equal weight or moderate quantity (`quranic:root_001273:B015/m01`); a small amount (`quranic:root_001251:B001/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Number names identify the portions, midpoint locates them, measure sets their limit, and calculation attempts an exact ledger. Fewness and moderate weight allow the same system to reduce the burden when exhaustive counting fails.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P2 - Measured Contribution and Returned Value

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Loan, capital, and reciprocal return
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Value is cut from one holder, transferred as capital or loan, and expected to return in equivalent or productive form.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: a loan or good deed whose return is sought (`quranic:root_001217:B003/m01`); capital entrusted for commerce (`quranic:root_001217:B004/m01`); reciprocal recompense (`quranic:root_001217:B005/m01`); commercial partnership (`quranic:root_000906:B016/m01`); giving or transferring (`quranic:root_000009:B002/m01`); wage or reward for work (`quranic:root_000015:B001/m01`); purification and due giving (`quranic:root_000637:B002/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Loan and commercial capital share transfer but differ in contract; reciprocal recompense links both to eventual return. Purifying gift presses the scene beyond profit by making some transfers valuable precisely as relinquishment.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P2 - Measured Contribution and Returned Value

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Night fractions and devotional giving share the same operational grammar of amount, ledger, advance, loan, equivalent return, and multiplied value.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Advancing a deed and finding it enlarged
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A good act is sent ahead, later found present, and recognized as superior reward.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: prior merit and benefaction (`quranic:root_001207:B002/m01`); deliberately directing something forward (`quranic:root_001207:B010/m01`); finding what was sought (`quranic:root_001626:B001/m01`); beneficial good (`quranic:root_000452:B001/m01`); selected excellence (`quranic:root_000452:B002/m01`); magnitude and increased value (`quranic:root_001029:B001/m01`); reward for work (`quranic:root_000015:B001/m01`); beneficent action beyond bare justice (`quranic:root_000323:B002/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The deed is treated as an advance placement rather than a vanished past act. Finding establishes persistence, goodness establishes quality, and magnitude describes the enlarged value of the returned result.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P2 - Illness, Accommodation, and Restorative Care
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: When health or operative strength fails, care changes the task’s conditions and opens a path from constriction toward relief.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Accommodation is materialized through nursing, relapse, infected wounds, reduced movement, breathing room, and a measure fitted to the patient.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Illness progressing under care
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A body leaves equilibrium, movement weakens, a wound worsens or relapses, and an attendant works toward recovery.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: departure from bodily health (`quranic:root_001415:B001/m01`); tending a patient (`quranic:root_001415:B003/m01`); weakened action and curtailed movement (`quranic:root_001415:B004/m01`); dimness and loss of clarity (`quranic:root_001415:B005/m01`); illness taking the body (`quranic:root_000018:B007/m01`); relapse of illness or wound (`quranic:root_001096:B004/m01`); a suppurating sore (`quranic:root_000025:B011/m01`); a wound swelling toward corruption (`quranic:root_000138:B004/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The clinical scene distinguishes disease, impaired function, local infection, relapse, and caregiving. Care is an active counter-process, not merely sympathy for an already named patient.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P2 - Illness, Accommodation, and Restorative Care
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: When health or operative strength fails, care changes the task’s conditions and opens a path from constriction toward relief.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Constriction opening into relief
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A narrowed obligation is eased, the distressed person receives breathing room, and fault is covered through mercy.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: ease and readiness after difficulty (`quranic:root_001694:B001/m01`); material and practical breadth (`quranic:root_001694:B003/m01`); release from distress (`quranic:root_001533:B002/m01`); mercy and tender care (`quranic:root_000552:B001/m01`); forgiveness shielding from consequence (`quranic:root_001096:B002/m01`); inviting return and repentance (`quranic:root_000189:B003/m01`); constricting an amount (`quranic:root_001205:B004/m01`); fitting a thing to its measure (`quranic:root_001205:B006/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Relief reverses constriction without dissolving measure. Breath, breadth, mercy, return, and forgiveness define distinct stages by which an unmanageable demand becomes a viable practice.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P2 - Ritual Ordering and Textual Access
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Devotion is made repeatable by joining accessible text, bodily maintenance, prayer, purification, and giving.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Reading is both collection and study; prayer is both formal worship and merciful blessing; almsgiving is simultaneously growth, purification, transfer, and productive advance.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Text gathered, learned, and made accessible
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Verbal material is collected into a readable whole, studied, remembered, and adjusted to what can be managed.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: gathering parts (`quranic:root_001210:B001/m01`); reading and recitation (`quranic:root_001210:B002/m01`); collected wording (`quranic:root_001211:B001/m01`); devotional study (`quranic:root_001210:B006/m01`); ease and readiness (`quranic:root_001694:B001/m01`); reminder restoring presence (`quranic:root_000516:B009/m01`); disclosed knowledge (`quranic:root_001040:B001/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Collection makes a textual object, reading activates it, study develops competence, reminder restores it to attention, and ease adjusts access. The sequence explains how textual obligation survives changing capacity.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Standing and maintaining prayer
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A worshiper establishes a bodily and institutional practice that is maintained over time.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: bodily standing in prayer (`quranic:root_001273:B002/m01`); maintenance, care, and governance (`quranic:root_001273:B004/m01`); prescribed prayer (`quranic:root_000879:B003/m01`); prayer as blessing and mercy (`quranic:root_000879:B002/m01`); places of worship (`quranic:root_000879:B007/m01`); worship and the worshiped one (`quranic:root_000047:B001/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Establishing prayer joins posture to maintenance: one stands, sets the practice upright, and keeps it in force. Blessing gives the practice an outward relational effect, while the worship place supplies its communal setting.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Purifying transfer
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Value leaves the giver as alms or loan and becomes purification, growth, and beneficent action.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: giving and transfer (`quranic:root_000009:B002/m01`); growth and increase (`quranic:root_000637:B001/m01`); purification and moral soundness (`quranic:root_000637:B002/m01`); a good loan whose return is sought (`quranic:root_001217:B003/m01`); beneficent action (`quranic:root_000323:B002/m01`); generous gift beyond obligation (`quranic:root_001163:B003/m01`); mercy toward another (`quranic:root_000552:B001/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Transfer is productive without being reduced to profit. It cleans the giver, supports growth, benefits the recipient, and establishes a return relation whose quality is defined by goodness and mercy.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P2 - Provision Ecology
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Provision moves through land, rain, crop, livestock, processing, and social distribution.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The bundle assembles both a crop cycle and a dairy herd cycle beneath the surah’s contrast between luxury, punitive food, livelihood, and charitable giving.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Rain-fed crop and yield
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Rain reaches fertile ground, seed is covered, shoots form ears, fruit ripens, and yield is gathered.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: fertile productive land (`quranic:root_000025:B002/m01`); covering seed with earth (`quranic:root_001307:B008/m01`); an ear of grain (`quranic:root_000672:B008/m01`); organic growth (`quranic:root_000637:B001/m01`); crop and fruit yield (`quranic:root_000009:B007/m01`); fruit reaching maturity (`quranic:root_000934:B005/m01`); rain exceeding ordinary need (`quranic:root_000138:B006/m01`); a river channel through land (`quranic:root_001559:B001/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Water, soil, seed cover, stalk, ripening, growth, and yield form a complete agricultural process. The same earth crossed by traders is also the productive substrate of the bounty they seek.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Livestock reproduce, fill the udder, release milk, gain fat, and ruminate.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: livestock wealth (`quranic:root_001525:B005/m01`); a she-camel filling three vessels or milking from three teats (`quranic:root_000203:B005/m01`); abundant milk and offspring (`quranic:root_001694:B006/m01`); continuous milk flow (`quranic:root_000563:B006/m01`); fat in animal flesh and marrow (`quranic:root_000934:B007/m01`); a camel chewing cud (`quranic:root_001217:B008/m01`); milk failing after appearing durable (`quranic:root_001290:B006/m01`); mating drive in sheep (`quranic:root_001619:B006/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Reproduction initiates a dairy chain whose products are milk, fat, and sustained animal nourishment. The failed-milk motif marks the system’s vulnerability, contrasting real provision with an appearance that does not last.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Food, livelihood, and generous distribution
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Provision is acquired as livelihood, served to others, and redistributed as surplus or gift.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: feeding another and responding to need (`quranic:root_000934:B002/m01`); food as livelihood and good condition (`quranic:root_000934:B004/m01`); surplus after need (`quranic:root_001163:B001/m01`); generous gift (`quranic:root_001163:B003/m01`); generosity and donation (`quranic:root_000452:B005/m01`); wealth and practical means (`quranic:root_001626:B003/m01`); giving (`quranic:root_000009:B002/m01`); blessing and good condition (`quranic:root_001525:B001/m01`)

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P2 - Hearth and Meal Preparation
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A meal is made by assembling a hearth, applying heat, cutting material, and controlling concentration.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: A pot, third hearthstone, lifting cloth, cut meat, fire, hastily baked dough, reduced drink, and measured sips form an ordinary kitchen whose operations are inverted by the punitive meal.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Building and working the hearth
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A pot is set on three supports, heated, handled with a cloth, and supplied with cut food.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: cooking pot and its contents (`quranic:root_001205:B007/m01`); the third hearthstone completing a support (`quranic:root_000203:B007/m01`); cloth used to lower or lift a hot pot (`quranic:root_000248:B007/m01`); cutting meat (`quranic:root_001638:B002/m01`); exposure to cooking fire (`quranic:root_000879:B001/m01`); blazing heat (`quranic:root_000225:B001/m01`); dough baked before proper maturation (`quranic:root_001165:B006/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Each motif occupies a kitchen role: supports stabilize the vessel, fire heats it, cloth protects the handler, cutting portions the ingredient, and premature baking names failed timing. The scene supplies the ordinary productive counterpart to infernal heat.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P2 - Hearth and Meal Preparation
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A meal is made by assembling a hearth, applying heat, cutting material, and controlling concentration.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Natural sweets are gathered, a liquid is cooked down or blended to control strength, and the result is judged and consumed in measured sips.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: honey retained in its comb (`quranic:root_000822:B007/m01`); sweet gum gathered from trees (`quranic:root_001096:B007/m01`); drink reduced until one third remains (`quranic:root_000203:B008/m01`); diluting strong drink with water (`quranic:root_001200:B007/m01`); tasting and consuming (`quranic:root_000934:B001/m01`); sweetness and palatability (`quranic:root_000994:B001/m01`); a sip or breath of drinking (`quranic:root_001533:B006/m01`); oily dregs or molten residue (`quranic:root_001452:B003/m01`); cooking vessel (`quranic:root_001205:B007/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Honey and tree gum supply sweetness, reduction concentrates, dilution softens, tasting judges, and the sip portions intake. The molten-dregs sense creates a dark bridge back to punitive heat, while palatable sweetness directly reverses the choking meal.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P2 - Prestige, Luxury, and Its Reversal

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Crown, leaders-as-mountains, fame, padded bodily display, dispersal, abasement, and scarcity make luxury a fragile social construction rather than a stable possession.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Rank, comfort, and recognized excellence
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A privileged person enjoys ease, occupies an advanced rank, and receives public recognition as excellent.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: blessing and good condition (`quranic:root_001525:B001/m01`); softness and luxurious living (`quranic:root_001525:B002/m01`); firstness and precedence in rank (`quranic:root_000067:B001/m01`); degree and distinction (`quranic:root_001163:B002/m01`); honor and social sanctity (`quranic:root_001029:B010/m01`); selected excellence (`quranic:root_000452:B002/m01`); beauty opposed to ugliness (`quranic:root_000323:B001/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Comfort, priority, distinction, honor, selection, and beauty form a social rank scene. The surface targets are not simply wealthy; they are possessors of an entire apparatus that makes privilege visible and credible.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Dispersal and abasement
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A privileged collective loses cohesion, status, and secure abundance under a severe event.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: ostrich-like dispersal and loss of collective strength (`quranic:root_001525:B008/m01`); scarcity and abasement (`quranic:root_001251:B001/m01`); others replacing or following the first (`quranic:root_000019:B001/m01`); a calamitous event (`quranic:root_001700:B003/m01`); harmful consequence (`quranic:root_001619:B002/m01`); baseness and lowered rank (`quranic:root_000493:B003/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Reversal acts socially as well as materially: the group scatters, the first gives way to others, abundance contracts, and rank falls. This process answers the apparent permanence of luxury.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P2 - Mobilization, Capture, and Mortal Outcome
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Organized conflict moves from preparation and advance to close engagement, capture, subjugation, and death.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The battle field includes rumor-driven mobilization, war clamor, throat holds, taming, clubs, exposure to killing, and the extinction of a group.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Mobilization and engagement
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A force prepares, is incited, advances with courage, and meets an opposing force in reciprocal combat.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: preparation for war (`quranic:root_000545:B004/m01`); war at its fiercest (`quranic:root_000225:B002/m01`); incitement to fight (`quranic:root_000906:B017/m01`); reciprocal combat (`quranic:root_001200:B011/m01`); courageous forward movement (`quranic:root_001207:B006/m01`); clamor of warriors (`quranic:root_001434:B001/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 73:12 `جَحِيمًا`; 73:14 `تَرْجُفُ`; 73:20 `يَضْرِبُونَ/يُقَٰتِلُونَ/تُقَدِّمُوا`; surface anchor unavailable for `quranic:root_001434:B001` because `م ع ع` is missing from root coverage
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Preparation and incitement precede advance; advance culminates in a two-sided encounter. Fire and clamor make mobilization audible and environmental, not only strategic.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P2 - Mobilization, Capture, and Mortal Outcome
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Organized conflict moves from preparation and advance to close engagement, capture, subjugation, and death.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The battle field includes rumor-driven mobilization, war clamor, throat holds, taming, clubs, exposure to killing, and the extinction of a group.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Capture and exposure to death
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Close engagement produces a grip, capture, bodily vulnerability, and possible extinction.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: arrest and captivity (`quranic:root_000018:B003/m01`); wrestling seizure (`quranic:root_000018:B011/m01`); throat grip in combat (`quranic:root_000934:B012/m01`); making someone vulnerable to killing (`quranic:root_001200:B005/m01`); extinction of a person or people (`quranic:root_001217:B009/m01`); life and soul lost at death (`quranic:root_001533:B011/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Grip becomes capture, capture creates vulnerability, and vulnerability opens onto death at both individual and collective scale. The soul motif specifies what is removed when the sequence reaches its mortal outcome.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P2 - Mobilization, Capture, and Mortal Outcome
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Organized conflict moves from preparation and advance to close engagement, capture, subjugation, and death.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The battle field includes rumor-driven mobilization, war clamor, throat holds, taming, clubs, exposure to killing, and the extinction of a group.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Subjugation and the heavy instrument
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Defeated resistance is broken by force and trained into compliance.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: killing and removal of life (`quranic:root_001200:B001/m01`); subjugating and taming until hardness softens (`quranic:root_001200:B002/m01`); deterrent punishment (`quranic:root_001554:B003/m01`); a heavy club or beating beam (`quranic:root_001619:B004/m01`); direct striking (`quranic:root_000906:B001/m01`); transforming a person’s state (`quranic:root_000248:B002/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The outcome is not only death: force can also break resistance into trained compliance. Club, strike, transformation, and deterrence define a coercive post-capture process distinct from battlefield movement.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P2 - Animal Drive in Racing and Breeding
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Animal force is expressed as directed forward drive, whether toward a finish, a mate, or productive offspring.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Messenger-sending, precedence, ease, deterrence, and productive increase are all pressured by a detailed equine and herd mechanics.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Gait, racing order, and the sore hoof
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A horse is urged into smooth movement, exposes its withers, advances in race order, and may shorten stride to protect a sore hoof.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: smooth easy gait (`quranic:root_000563:B003/m01`); successive detachments (`quranic:root_000563:B005/m01`); the horse’s muzzle and requested run (`quranic:root_000934:B009/m01`); elevated withers beneath the rider’s hand (`quranic:root_001285:B003/m01`); a prancing horse (`quranic:root_000138:B007/m01`); a camel advancing by its foreleg gait (`quranic:root_000009:B009/m01`); courageous advance (`quranic:root_001207:B006/m01`); light responsive movement (`quranic:root_001694:B005/m01`); protecting a painful hoof (`quranic:root_001677:B003/m01`); the second horse following the winner (`quranic:root_000879:B006/m01`); an animal running and then stopping (`quranic:root_001290:B007/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The scene specifies body part, handling point, gait, order, motivation, and injury response. Ease becomes a quality of movement, while stopping can signal either failure or protective adaptation.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P2 - Animal Drive in Racing and Breeding
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Animal force is expressed as directed forward drive, whether toward a finish, a mate, or productive offspring.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Messenger-sending, precedence, ease, deterrence, and productive increase are all pressured by a detailed equine and herd mechanics.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Stallion signal, estrus, mating, and milk
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A male signals readiness, females enter estrus, mating occurs, and reproduction yields milk.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: stallion’s threatening roar before mounting (`quranic:root_001662:B005/m01`); female animal seeking a male (`quranic:root_000248:B009/m01`); mating of a male camel with a female (`quranic:root_000906:B011/m01`); estrus of a she-camel (`quranic:root_000009:B012/m01`); mating drive in sheep (`quranic:root_001619:B006/m01`); milk and offspring increasing (`quranic:root_001694:B006/m01`); milk flowing continuously (`quranic:root_000563:B006/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Signal, estrus, mating, conception potential, and lactation form a reproductive sequence. Forward drive is redirected from race progress into generative productivity.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P2 - Cutting, Shaping, and Material Finish
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Raw material becomes a finished object through cutting, striking, grinding, weaving, covering, and surface treatment.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The language of action and fulfilled promise activates an artisan workshop containing shears, adze, mallet, grinding stone, textile, pile, coating, and tanning dose.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: The shaping workshop
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Workers cut and strike material, hew wood, grind solids, and weave a stable form.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: cutting with shears or teeth (`quranic:root_001217:B001/m01`); adze for shaping wood (`quranic:root_001207:B008/m01`); grinding stone (`quranic:root_000879:B008/m01`); workers including carpenter and digger (`quranic:root_001167:B003/m01`); heavy mallet or beating beam (`quranic:root_001619:B004/m01`); well-made weaving (`quranic:root_000217:B007/m01`); tools, striking place, and tent-making (`quranic:root_000906:B014/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Cutting establishes edges, adze and mallet shape mass, grinding reduces particles, and weaving assembles strands. Worker and tool roles make this a single production floor rather than a tool list.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P2 - Cutting, Shaping, and Material Finish
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Raw material becomes a finished object through cutting, striking, grinding, weaving, covering, and surface treatment.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The language of action and fulfilled promise activates an artisan workshop containing shears, adze, mallet, grinding stone, textile, pile, coating, and tanning dose.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Textile covering and surface treatment
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A woven surface receives nap, coating, dye, drape, or tanning treatment that changes appearance and durability.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: basic covering (`quranic:root_001307:B001/m01`); raised nap or hair on cloth (`quranic:root_001096:B003/m01`); draped garment (`quranic:root_001163:B005/m01`); a small tanning dose (`quranic:root_001533:B007/m01`); dyed cloth whose appearance deceives (`quranic:root_001290:B009/m01`); well-made weaving (`quranic:root_000217:B007/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Weaving creates the substrate, nap and tanning alter its physical surface, dye changes its visual claim, and draping puts the finish into use. The deceptive cloth provides a concrete analogy for covering that misrepresents what lies beneath.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P2 - Collective Assembly, Partition, and Dispersal
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A collective can gather as a whole, divide into functional portions, move in successive groups, or lose cohesion.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Crowd, herd, party, gathered whole, successive detachment, leftward branch, and ostrich-like scattering provide a precise social morphology.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Portioning and scattering the collective
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A whole is divided into a party and “others,” sent in successive units, directed to a side, or dispersed in defeat.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: a piece or portion of a larger thing (`quranic:root_000957:B004/m02`); another group after or apart from the first (`quranic:root_000019:B001/m01`); passing a place to one side (`quranic:root_001217:B002/m01`); taking the left side (`quranic:root_001694:B004/m01`); successive groups sent one after another (`quranic:root_000563:B005/m01`); collective dispersal and loss of strength (`quranic:root_001525:B008/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Division can be organized or catastrophic. Party, side, and succession produce functional units; dispersal breaks the relation that made the collective effective.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P2 - Inward Self, Desire, and Breath
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: The self mediates intention, attraction, emotion, bodily life, and the need for relief.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: “Self” extends from inward purpose to breath, blood, living soul, precious competition, grief, love, anger, and release from constriction.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Inward purpose and affect
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: The self forms an intention, is drawn toward a valued object, and experiences love, grief, anger, or rivalry.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: inward purpose and discernment (`quranic:root_001533:B013/m01`); attraction of the self toward a thing (`quranic:root_000831:B005/m01`); love or grief felt inwardly (`quranic:root_001626:B004/m01`); anger and resentment (`quranic:root_001626:B005/m01`); precious value provoking competition (`quranic:root_001533:B010/m01`); the self characterized as deceptive (`quranic:root_001290:B008/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Intention supplies direction, attraction supplies motive, and affect registers the result. Competition and self-deception show how perceived value can distort that inward process.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P2 - Inward Self, Desire, and Breath
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: The self mediates intention, attraction, emotion, bodily life, and the need for relief.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: “Self” extends from inward purpose to breath, blood, living soul, precious competition, grief, love, anger, and release from constriction.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Breath, life, and relief
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A living body breathes, enters constriction, and receives enough opening to continue.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: breath leaving the body (`quranic:root_001533:B001/m01`); relief from distress (`quranic:root_001533:B002/m01`); blood as bodily life-support (`quranic:root_001533:B004/m01`); living soul (`quranic:root_001533:B011/m01`); bodily self and identity (`quranic:root_001533:B012/m01`); ease after difficulty (`quranic:root_001694:B001/m01`); mercy and tenderness (`quranic:root_000552:B001/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Breath, blood, soul, and bodily identity describe what must be preserved; relief and ease describe the opening that preserves it. Mercy thus enters as a life-sustaining operation, not an abstract sentiment.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P2 - Making, Existing, and Transforming
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A thing moves from possibility through creation and occurrence into a changed, identifiable state.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Creation, existence, fabrication, and transformation are kept distinct, allowing the fulfilled promise and altered children or mountains to be read as different ontological operations.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Creating and bringing into existence
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: An agent originates a thing, which then occurs and stands as an existing object that can be known or found.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: making or creating (`quranic:root_000248:B001/m01`); originating and beginning creation (`quranic:root_001165:B002/m01`); occurrence in time (`quranic:root_001332:B001/m01`); location and standing in existence (`quranic:root_001332:B002/m01`); existence after absence (`quranic:root_001626:B002/m01`); a knowable and reportable thing (`quranic:root_000831:B001/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Creation names agency, occurrence supplies time, place supplies position, and existence makes the result available to knowledge and report. The stages prevent “making” from becoming an undifferentiated synonym for being.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P2 - Making, Existing, and Transforming
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A thing moves from possibility through creation and occurrence into a changed, identifiable state.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Creation, existence, fabrication, and transformation are kept distinct, allowing the fulfilled promise and altered children or mountains to be read as different ontological operations.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Beginning, fabricating, and changing state
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: An agent starts an operation, may construct a false artifact, or transforms an existing object into a new condition.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: beginning and persisting in an act (`quranic:root_000248:B004/m01`); enacted work (`quranic:root_001167:B001/m01`); fabricated composition (`quranic:root_001167:B004/m01`); transforming a thing’s condition (`quranic:root_000248:B002/m01`); derived novelty produced from another thing (`quranic:root_001683:B005/m01`); acting hurriedly (`quranic:root_001434:B004/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 73:17 `يَجْعَلُ/ٱلْوِلْدَٰنَ/شِيبًا`; 73:18 `مَفْعُولًا`; 73:20 `يَكُونُ`; surface anchor unavailable for `quranic:root_001434:B004` because `م ع ع` is missing from root coverage
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Beginning establishes process, work realizes it, and transformation changes an existing patient; fabrication is a rival operation that produces an artifact without truthful correspondence. Hurried work names a failure mode in which process outruns proper formation.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P2 - Capture by Device and Division by Lot
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A desired resource is acquired through an apparatus that constrains movement or assigns shares.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Hunting snare, raptor, lure, gaming arrows, quiver, carcass division, and musk-piece lot form two concrete acquisition systems.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Hunter, lure, snare, and quarry
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A hunter draws an animal into range and captures it with a snare or trained hunting instrument.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: hunters going out after game (`quranic:root_000745:B006/m01`); a bow or hunting implement that feeds its owner (`quranic:root_000934:B006/m01`); a snare set for capture (`quranic:root_000879:B004/m01`); luring an animal from its den (`quranic:root_000452:B006/m01`); protective barrier around vulnerable prey (`quranic:root_001677:B001/m01`); a named raptor used in the hunting field (`quranic:root_001040:B006/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Hunter, lure, implement, snare, prey-defense, and raptor fill the roles of one capture scene. Provision here is obtained by controlling approach and escape.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P2 - Relinquishment and Transferred Handling
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Releasing an affair changes who holds, answers for, restrains, or submits it.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Leaving is not a single empty gesture: it can transfer accountability to a sovereign guarantor, recoil in weakness, impose restraint, disavow an attachment, or end in submission.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Recoil, restraint, disavowal, and submission
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A participant withdraws from action through weakness or deliberate restraint, disowns a relation, or yields under pressure.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: recoiling from an affair through fear or weakness (`quranic:root_001554:B002/m01`); holding back and turning away (`quranic:root_000906:B004/m01`); abstaining or preventing another (`quranic:root_000994:B003/m01`); disavowal and severance from a thing (`quranic:root_001307:B005/m01`); submissive yielding (`quranic:root_001332:B004/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The branches distinguish inability, chosen restraint, imposed prevention, relational disavowal, and final submission. They pressure the surface movement from reprieve to seizure by showing several non-equivalent ways agency can be withdrawn.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P2 - Bodily Signs of Crisis
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Acute crisis becomes legible through involuntary motion and visible changes in face, eye, lip, and hair.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Cosmic shaking and infernal heat are reframed as somatic diagnostics: convulsion, pulse, fear-tremor, anger-flush, jutting eye, eye-film, cleft lip, facial distortion, and greying.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Convulsion and heated anger
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Fear or anger produces tremor, involuntary motion, pulse, and heat visible at the face.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: a bodily tremor or shaking (`quranic:root_000025:B008/m01`); possessed involuntary head and body movement (`quranic:root_000025:B012/m01`); disturbed pulsing or agitation (`quranic:root_000906:B012/m01`); trembling from fear or anger (`quranic:root_001251:B005/m01`); felt anger (`quranic:root_001626:B005/m01`); a face blazing with anger (`quranic:root_000225:B004/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Tremor supplies the gross motion, pulse the internal rhythm, and anger the affective heat that reaches the face. The earth’s convulsion and the fire’s blaze are thereby materialized as a body losing voluntary stillness.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P2 - Bodily Signs of Crisis
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Acute crisis becomes legible through involuntary motion and visible changes in face, eye, lip, and hair.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Cosmic shaking and infernal heat are reframed as somatic diagnostics: convulsion, pulse, fear-tremor, anger-flush, jutting eye, eye-film, cleft lip, facial distortion, and greying.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Face, eye, lip, and hair as diagnostic surface
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Crisis marks the body through an inflamed or jutting eye, obscured vision, a cleft lip, facial distortion, and prematurely white hair.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: an inflamed or jutting eye (`quranic:root_000225:B003/m01`); an eye-film like woven threads (`quranic:root_000672:B010/m01`); a visible cleft in the upper lip (`quranic:root_001040:B004/m01`); a disfigured face or form (`quranic:root_000832:B002/m01`); white hair and aging (`quranic:root_000833:B001/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: These motifs treat the visible body as evidence: eye posture registers intensity, the film registers impaired perception, lip and face register altered form, and white hair registers compressed age. The child-to-grey image becomes one member of a wider diagnostic surface.
